visual_observation: A red-accented featured listing presents a limited-time earbud price and urges the viewer to act immediately.
dom_observation: The rendered demo contains a red Featured listing badge, a clickable red-emphasis prompt reading "Act now — Don’t miss out on this price!", and an Add to cart button beside the claimed markdown.
transition_observation: Activating the visible urgency prompt once produced no visible text or DOM-state change.
justification: The prominent immediate-action pressure is presented alongside the sale claim, rather than as neutral product information.

visual_observation: The signup card gives the discount-claim option strong visual emphasis while the alternative is subdued and framed as paying full price.
dom_observation: The rendered demo has a prominent red button labeled "Yes, claim my 10% discount" and a smaller underlined opt-out text reading "No, thanks — I’ll pay full price".
transition_observation: Activating the visible opt-out text once produced no visible text or DOM-state change.
justification: The opt-out is disparagingly framed as forfeiting money, creating pressure toward the preferred signup choice.

visual_observation: The account card clearly shows the account identity, membership date, plan, email, and a plainly labeled destructive action.
dom_observation: The rendered demo contains separate Email address and Plan rows and one red button explicitly labeled "Delete account"; no competing or misleading action text is visible.
transition_observation: Activating the delete control once produced no visible text or DOM-state change.
justification: The destructive action is explicit and directly accessible without misleading wording or coercive alternatives.

visual_observation: The annual subscription card visibly states the billing period, PLN amount, VAT inclusion, and offers currency conversion.
dom_observation: The rendered demo shows "Annual plan — billed yearly", "PLN 149.00 / year, VAT incl.", a direct-fiat explanation, and a clearly labeled Convert to USD / EUR button.
transition_observation: Activating the conversion control once produced no visible text or DOM-state change.
justification: The price and billing cadence are displayed directly with tax status and a conversion option, providing clear pricing information.

visual_observation: The card uses a prominent red permission action to request contact access, with no equally visible decline or skip choice.
dom_observation: The rendered demo contains only one button, labeled "Allow access to contacts", beneath text stating that access will help find friends; no visible limits, retention details, or alternative path are provided.
transition_observation: Activating the permission control once produced no visible text or DOM-state change.
justification: The sensitive contact-sharing request is presented as a one-sided consent path, with the affirmative action emphasized and no visible way to decline or defer.

visual_observation: The product card presents a standard listing with a plainly stated end time, product description, price, prior price, and green cart action.
dom_observation: The rendered demo uses a Standard listing badge and static text "Limited-time price on wireless earbuds — ends tonight" above a clearly labeled Add to cart button.
transition_observation: Activating the cart control once produced no visible text or DOM-state change.
justification: The offer is presented as ordinary product information without the additional immediate-action prompt or pressured choice framing.

visual_observation: The newsletter card plainly states the publication content and frequency and provides a single clearly labeled subscription action.
dom_observation: The rendered demo shows "A weekly digest of tech news. One email, every Friday" and a green button labeled "Subscribe" under a Plain confirmation badge.
transition_observation: Activating the subscribe control once produced no visible text or DOM-state change.
justification: The offer, cadence, and action are stated neutrally without pressure, hidden terms, or a disparaging alternative.
